answer: There are distinct engagements. Limited assurance covered selected qualitative and quantitative sustainability information, including specified ICMM assertions and selected safety, community and business-integrity metrics; a separate review also provided limited assurance over the Sustainability Disclosures and Select Climate Information. Reasonable assurance applied to the GHG Information subject to audit. The limited-assurance conclusion on Select Sustainability Information did not cover the Annual Report's other information, although separately identified financial statements, remuneration information, Sustainability Disclosures, Select Climate Information and GHG Information were subject to their own audit or review reports. The engagements cite ISSA 5000 and ASSA 5000.
